# India Company Setup — PGA & Co.

> India Company Setup (indiacompanysetup.com) is a professional advisory platform by PGA & Co., Chartered Accountants, specialising in foreign company registration in India, FDI compliance, international taxation, and post-incorporation regulatory support. We help businesses from the USA, UK, UAE, Singapore, Canada, and Australia set up legal entities in India.

## Core Services

- [Setup & Incorporation](https://www.indiacompanysetup.com/setup): End-to-end company formation in India — Private Limited, Subsidiary, Branch Office, Liaison Office.
- [Post-Setup Compliance](https://www.indiacompanysetup.com/post-setup): Ongoing regulatory, accounting, payroll, and ROC compliance after incorporation.
- [International Tax](https://www.indiacompanysetup.com/international-tax): DTAA planning, FEMA compliance, transfer pricing, cross-border structuring.

## Company Registration by Country

- [From USA](https://www.indiacompanysetup.com/company-registration/from-usa): Guide for US companies and entrepreneurs registering a company in India.
- [From UK](https://www.indiacompanysetup.com/company-registration/from-uk): Guide for UK companies setting up operations in India.
- [From Dubai / UAE](https://www.indiacompanysetup.com/company-registration/from-dubai): Guide for UAE and GCC-based businesses entering the Indian market.
- [From Singapore](https://www.indiacompanysetup.com/company-registration/from-singapore): Guide for Singapore companies and investors registering in India.
- [From Canada](https://www.indiacompanysetup.com/company-registration/from-canada): Guide for Canadian companies incorporating a subsidiary or branch in India.
- [From Australia](https://www.indiacompanysetup.com/company-registration/from-australia): Guide for Australian businesses setting up a legal entity in India.

## High-Value Advisory Pages

- [Foreign Company Registration India](https://www.indiacompanysetup.com/foreign-company-registration-india): Types of structures available to foreign companies under the Companies Act 2013.
- [Private Limited Company Registration](https://www.indiacompanysetup.com/private-limited-company-registration-india): Step-by-step process, documents, timeline, and costs.
- [Subsidiary Company India](https://www.indiacompanysetup.com/subsidiary-company-india): Wholly-owned subsidiary vs joint venture — structure and compliance.
- [NRI Company Registration](https://www.indiacompanysetup.com/nri-company-registration-india): How Non-Resident Indians can set up a company in India.
- [FDI Rules India](https://www.indiacompanysetup.com/fdi-rules-india): Sector-wise FDI limits, automatic vs government route, prohibited sectors.
- [Transfer Pricing India](https://www.indiacompanysetup.com/transfer-pricing-india): TP documentation, benchmarking, and compliance for related-party transactions.
- [GCC Setup India](https://www.indiacompanysetup.com/gcc-setup-india): Setting up a Global Capability Centre (GCC) in India.
- [India Market Entry Advisory](https://www.indiacompanysetup.com/india-market-entry-advisory): Market entry strategy, entity selection, and go-to-market support.
- [Startup Foreign Funding](https://www.indiacompanysetup.com/startup-foreign-investment-india): FEMA and RBI rules for Indian startups receiving foreign investment.

## Free Tax & Compliance Tools

- [Income Tax Calculator](https://www.indiacompanysetup.com/tools/income-tax-calculator): FY 2025-26 income tax calculator for individuals — new and old regime, with marginal relief u/s 87A.
- [Payroll Calculator](https://www.indiacompanysetup.com/tools/payroll-calculator): CTC-to-take-home salary calculator with PF, professional tax, and TDS.
- [Capital Gains Calculator](https://www.indiacompanysetup.com/tools/capital-gains-calculator): Tax on STCG and LTCG — equity, property, debt funds; Budget 2025 rates.
- [TDS Rate Chart FY 2026-27](https://www.indiacompanysetup.com/tools/tds-rates): Section-wise TDS rates and thresholds under IT Act 1961 and IT Act 2025.
- [Advance Tax Calculator](https://www.indiacompanysetup.com/tools/advance-tax-calculator): Instalment schedule and due dates for advance tax payments.
- [DTAA Rate Finder](https://www.indiacompanysetup.com/tools/dtaa-rate-finder): Withholding tax rates under India's Double Tax Avoidance Agreements.
- [FDI Sector Checker](https://www.indiacompanysetup.com/tools/fdi-sector-checker): Look up FDI limits and entry routes for any industry sector in India.
- [GST Due Dates](https://www.indiacompanysetup.com/tools/gst-due-dates): Monthly and quarterly GST return filing deadlines for FY 2025-26.
- [HSN / SAC Code Finder](https://www.indiacompanysetup.com/tools/hsn-sac-finder): Search HSN codes for goods and SAC codes for services under GST.
- [Company Name Check](https://www.indiacompanysetup.com/tools/company-name-check): Check name availability for MCA company registration.
